triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: When Mitya began to speak of his quarrel with his father over his inheritance, the priest was positively alarmed, as he was in some way dependent on Fyodor Pavlovitch.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: When Mitya began to speak of his quarrel with his father over his inheritance, the priest was positively alarmed, as he was in some way dependent on Fyodor Pavlovitch.

triples.subject: Gorstkin
triples.quote: he was now at Suhoy Possyolok, that he was staying the night in the forester’s cottage, as he was buying timber there too.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: But he had at home an old silver watch which had long ceased to go. He snatched it up and carried it to a Jewish watchmaker who had a shop in the market-place.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: I’m Lieutenant Dmitri Karamazov, the son of the old Karamazov whose copse you are buying.

triples.subject: Lieutenant Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: No, you show me this: you tell me the law that allows roguery. D’you hear? You’re a scoundrel! Do you understand that?” Mitya stepped back gloomily

triples.subject: Lieutenant Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: But the thought of her was stabbing him to the heart every moment, like a sharp knife. At last they arrived, and Mitya at once ran to Grushenka.
